spanish: Y verá la plaga en el día el séptimo: cuando se extendió la plaga en el vestido o en la urdimbre o en la trama o en la piel, a todo lo que se haga la piel a obra, lepra maligna la plaga; impura ella.
grammarChanges: Translated the untranslated common noun tsaráat to lepra (h03013051021), per the auditor fail; left maligna la plaga unchanged.

Kept impura/ella feminine to agree with the Spanish noun la plaga; the Hebrew adjective and pronoun (h03013051024, h03013051025) are masculine and cannot both be kept with that Spanish noun — see readerNote.
readerNote: Hebrew טָמֵא הוּא is masculine, agreeing with the masculine Hebrew noun behind "the plague"; Spanish keeps impura/ella feminine to agree with the chosen Spanish noun la plaga, since both genders cannot be kept at once.
